title: Two Women in Winter Snow, 1948 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length black and white snapshot taken on January 11, 1948, showing an elderly woman wearing spectacles alongside a young woman in styled 1940s hair standing together in a snowy residential yard. Both women are dressed in heavy winter coats, dark stockings, and heels. In the background are bare trees and a American residential home typical of the post-WWII era.
